parameters.name: filter[queue]
parameters.description: Filter to a single Horizon queue name.

parameters.name: filter[supervisor]
parameters.description: Filter to a single supervisor name. Derived from queueToSupervisorMap (queue → supervisor). Useful for drilling in from the Queues table on the overview.

parameters.name: filter[tenant_id]
parameters.description: Filter to jobs tagged with the given tenant id.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search across class, queue, tenant_id, and id.
